mechanism: Whole-line image-label permutations do not condition on fixed label-specific readable exposures inside CMH folio/wrap strata. The single FG readable slot in f80v/short has a discrete heavy conditional null tail; shuffles typically replace this with much larger FG exposure, producing an inappropriate tail for the actual fixed design.
other_findings: Original observed CMH iid mean statistics are near rank3; not a general statistic-scale inflation.
Rank mixture and acceleration do not explain inspected flags.
Fixed-margin selected position-null examples still flag: within-stratum original-position heterogeneity is outside the conditional exchangeability null.
Sparse or dominant folio support failures are distinct from false positives and remain failures.
limitations: Attribution is diagnostic, not a mathematical proof that every flag has one cause; full paired control rerun will test repair calibration and scope.
